description: This file contains CMake functions and macros for managing build configurations, including target link libraries, compile options, include directories, and installation procedures for CMake and package configuration files. It defines helper functions to facilitate target property management, package and module installation, and versioning support.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: Appends an element to a specified list variable.

methods.name: _get_default_link_name
methods.description: Derives the link name and location from a library path, removing prefixes and extensions.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Retrieves the link libraries and directories associated with a target, including interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Fetches compile definitions for a target, including inherited interface definitions.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Retrieves compile options for a target, including inherited interface options.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Gets the include directories for a target, including interface directories, resolving paths accordingly.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Installs CMake configuration files (.cmake) for a target, including version and dependencies.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Installs pkg-config (.pc) files for a target, with support for custom templates and configuration.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Installs CMake module find scripts from a specified directory, optionally recursively.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Prints the list of all CMake property names supported.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Outputs all properties of a specified target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Replaces semicolons in a string with a safe placeholder character.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Creates and installs a legacy compatible CMake interface target, linking to an existing target, and optionally exposing public headers.
